content: उत्क्षिप्त {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Thrown upwards, tossed, raised. .²2 Held up, supported; तत्र नागफणोत्क्षिप्तसिंहासन निषेदुषी <ls>R. 15. 83</ls>. .²3 Seized or overcome with, distracted by, struck with; विस्मय˚ <ls>Ratn. 1</ls>; so लोभ˚, अनुराग˚. .²4 Demolished, destroyed. .²5 Thrown out, rejected, dismissed. .{@-प्तः@} The thorn apple, the Dhaūttra plant क्षणं क्षणोत्क्षिप्तगजेन्द्रकृत्तिना <ls>Śi.</ls>
